summary: Import thunk for the AVIFileExit AVI library routine. It unconditionally forwards to the import address table entry __imp_AVIFileExit at 0x0059E04C and returns. The function has no parameters and no explicit body beyond the indirection.

operations.description: Indirect call through the import address table pointer __imp_AVIFileExit (0x0059E04C) to the imported AVIFileExit routine.
Void thunk returns immediately after the forwarded call completes.

unresolved: The side effects of the imported AVIFileExit routine are not visible at this thunk and depend on the AVI library implementation.
